title: The Los Angeles Podcast
author: Joe Copeland & Jay Guzman
description: Joe Copeland and Jay Guzman are two natives from the City of Los Angeles. Join us as we share our adventures exploring this great city, eating food from every ethnicity, and interacting with other fascinating people who love this crazy city we call home.
